rationale: The bounce off the $9.86 low is accelerating on rising volume (last three candles up: 6.2k → 11.1k → 7.1k shares), and price has reclaimed both the 5-min VWAP ($10.38) and the 9-EMA ($10.40), directly contradicting the short's momentum-continuation thesis while the original invalidation at $10.52 sits only ~0.8% away. With maximum favorable excursion of just 0.10% and a risk-on tape (SPY +0.96%), holding offers poor risk/reward, but a flip long is not justified since the stock remains nearly 10% below session VWAP in a heavy intraday downtrend and the 19bp spread would punish re-entry.
